announcements.title: Course Webpage
announcements.description: Visit the course webpage at www.cs.ucla.edu/classes/spring2016/cs111 for organizational material.

announcements.title: Piazza Setup
announcements.description: Join Piazza for course communication; setup is expected tomorrow.

announcements.title: Enrollment Assistance
announcements.description: For enrollment issues, attend class and speak with the instructor on days other than today.

datetime_parameters.raw_time_text: not today, but maybe in later days

announcements.title: PPEs for Enrollment
announcements.description: PPEs are given out in week two for students trying to get into the class.

announcements.title: Written Report Resources
announcements.description: Consult the page on resources for written reports.

announcements.title: Virtual Machine Setup
announcements.description: Set up your virtual machine earlier rather than later, not 30 minutes before the due date.

announcements.title: UPE Tutoring
announcements.description: Consult UPE Tutoring for course questions; they have regular office hours.

announcements.title: POSIX Documentation
announcements.description: Resources on POSIX, the Portable Operating System Standard, are available.

announcements.title: Linux Documentation
announcements.description: Use the Linux documentation project for command pages and other Linux information.

announcements.title: Operating Systems Wikipedia
announcements.description: The Wikipedia page on operating systems can be a useful source of information.

announcements.title: ECM SIG OS
announcements.description: The ECM special interest group in operating systems is for advanced topics.

announcements.title: Lab Zero Weight
announcements.description: Lab Zero is worth 3% of the total grade.

announcements.title: Other Labs Weight
announcements.description: Four more labs are worth 8% each, totaling 32% of the grade.

announcements.title: Report Weight
announcements.description: A report due near the end of the quarter is worth 3% of the grade.

announcements.title: Class Participation
announcements.description: Class participation on Piazza is worth 1% of the grade, with 0.1% per approved post, maxing out at 1%.

announcements.title: Feedback Survey Credit
announcements.description: Receive 0.25% credit for filling out a feedback survey mid-term and another at the end of the course.

announcements.title: Course Evaluation Credit
announcements.description: Receive 0.25% credit for each of the two course evaluations (instructor and TA), totaling 0.5%.

announcements.title: Midterm Exam
announcements.description: The midterm exam is worth 25% of the grade and will be held in this room during the fifth week, on Wednesday.

announcements.title: Final Exam
announcements.description: The final exam is worth 35% of the grade.

announcements.title: Exam Rules
announcements.description: Exams are open book and open notes, but only printed or written materials are allowed; no automated devices.

announcements.title: Submission Deadline Rule
announcements.description: Submissions are accepted up until 23:55 on the due date. Late submissions incur penalties.

datetime_parameters.raw_time_text: up until five minutes before midnight on the due dates

announcements.title: Late Submission Penalty
announcements.description: Late submissions incur a 1% penalty per day, with the penalty tripling for each extra day late.

announcements.title: Final Assignment Deadline
announcements.description: No assignments will be accepted after Friday of week 10 at 23:55.

announcements.title: Plagiarism Policy
announcements.description: Submitting copied work or work generated by AI without proper attribution is considered plagiarism and will be reported to the dean.

announcements.title: Generative AI Usage
announcements.description: Use generative AI as a study aid, not to solve problems directly. Include prompts and responses as an appendix if used.

announcements.title: Sharing Answers
announcements.description: Do not share answers or solutions with other students.

announcements.title: Email Communication
announcements.description: Keep emails to the instructor short, preferably text-only, with a clear subject line, to avoid spam filters.

announcements.title: Email Attachments
announcements.description: Avoid using attachments in emails to the instructor; if necessary, notify the instructor about the attachment.

announcements.title: Prerequisites
announcements.description: Prerequisites include CS32 (C++ data structures, OOP), CS33 (machine organization, assembly), and CS35L (scripting, software tools).

announcements.title: Recommended Courses
announcements.description: Networking (CS118) and Programming Languages are recommended but not required prerequisites.

announcements.title: Architecture Course
announcements.description: CS151b (Architecture) is recommended.

announcements.title: Course Structure
announcements.description: The course includes 4 hours of lecture, 2 hours of lab, and an estimated 9 hours of outside study per week.

announcements.title: Textbooks
announcements.description: Two main textbooks are used: one free PDF (Remzi and Arpazzi-Basso) and one available on campus (Sasser & Kaser). Additional readings by Mark Camp are also assigned.

announcements.title: Break Time
announcements.description: A break will be taken, resuming at 2 past the hour.

announcements.title: Operating System Definition
announcements.description: The definition of an operating system from the American Heritage Dictionary (2000) is software designed to control hardware to allow users to utilize data processing systems.

announcements.title: Wikipedia Definition
announcements.description: Wikipedia defines an operating system as system software that manages computer hardware and software resources and provides common services.
